text:
Maria (CS): Quick intake: SwiftMed wants to bring a customer-fine-tuned 13B into Private + HSM. Theyre processing PHI and expect <60ms p50. Renewal conversation in ~45 days, so we need a tight plan.

Leo (Solutions): What format did they send? any quantized weights? also curious about max tokens for their use-case.

Maria (CS): Sent a link to `swiftmed_model_v3.tar.gz` (fp16), no quant. Typical prompt length ~400 tokens, worst-case 1024. Theyre asking if we can do int8 or 4-bit to meet latency.

Dana (T&S): PHI + clinical notes. Must have redacted validation set + signed safety checklist before Private deploy. We'll need to run PHI leakage scans, and regression tests against our anchor prompts.

Priya (Ops): I'll set up a pre-onboard sync. Proposed schedule: ingest artifact Tue, compatibility/perf Wed, safety + regression Thu, canary Fri-Mon. Is that aggressive?

Leo (Solutions): It's doable if artifact is clean. Plan: run compatibility, then try 8-bit and 4-bit (GPTQ) locally. If quant harms accuracy on our regression set, fallback to int8 only. Need to confirm HSM wrapping workflow for model keys.

Omar (AM): Heads-up on renewal: SwiftMed is evaluating alternatives. If we can demonstrate a safe canary with clear perf numbers within a week, that materially helps renewal. Can we offer a short free canary credit?

Maria (CS): Customer is open to a 5-day canary on Dedicated. They also want an enablement session for their infra team on secrets + key rotation.

DeployBot: Calendar: "SwiftMed private model pre-onboard" scheduled Tue 09:00 UTC. Attendees: ops+solutions+t&s+cs+am.

Dana (T&S): Minimal eval matrix I'm requesting: 1) 1000 redacted QA pairs for regression, 2) PHI token detection scan, 3) 200 adversarial prompts for prompt-injection, 4) hallucination rate over clinical baselines. Please supply pass targets.

Leo (Solutions): Draft eval config I'll run: 
```
model_label: swiftmed-13b-v3
batch: 4
quant_tests: [none, int8, int4_gptq]
perf_goal: {p50_ms: 60}
eval_files: [swiftmed_redacted_eval.json]
```

Priya (Ops): Canary plan outline: 3-day canary on Dedicated (1x A10G equiv), telemetry hooks (latency, error, PHI alerts), auto-rollback if PHI leakage detected or p95 > 250ms for >5m window. Estimate cost and permission scoping in doc.

Omar (AM): Please add an enablement checklist for their SREs: (1) deploying SDK clients, (2) key import to HSM, (3) emergency fallback to hosted model endpoints. Well use that in renewal call.

Maria (CS): Action items: Leo -> perf + quant runs (Wed EOD), Dana -> safety checklist + threshold proposals (Thu AM), Priya -> canary budget + runbook (Tue before call), Omar -> renewal play + enablement slides. I'll collate notes and send to SwiftMed post-call.

Leo (Solutions): Will post raw perf logs here when initial run finishes. Small note: if we do 4-bit GPTQ we should test a tiny calibration set as it can regress on rare clinical tokens.

Dana (T&S): Agreed. Also request their security contact for HIPAA paperwork. No Private deploy without signed checklist and redacted eval set.

Maria (CS): Thanks. This is high priority for account health. Updating thread after Tue sync. :rocket:
